patch_description: The current program's weakness is its crude relaxation heuristic — the "contact_relax" step only moves centers based on a single nearest neighbor and the proportional-scaling radius assignment does not jointly optimize centers and radii. The gap to 2.635 requires a proper joint nonlinear optimization: treat all 26 centers and radii as decision variables (78 dims), maximize sum(r) subject to pairwise non-overlap constraints r_i + r_j <= d_ij and wall constraints r_i <= min(x_i, y_i, 1-x_i, 1-y_i). SLSQP handles this well from a feasible lattice seed. Additionally, since SLSQP may end slightly infeasible, we add a guaranteed repair step (shrink radii until feasible), then re-run SLSQP a second "polish" pass from the repaired point so fine-grained contact adjustments can be made. This replaces the ad-hoc contact relaxation with a principled optimizer while remaining deterministic.
